ratios.quote: The Partnership's net leverage ratio was 3.5 to 1.00 at September 30, 2026.

parsed.notes: The net leverage ratio appears in the Credit Facility section, right after the statement that the Partnership was in compliance with all financial covenants. The excerpt does not state the covenant's maximum, so the limit is null. The direction (max) is inferred because this is a leverage-type covenant.
